'''Incineration''' was a [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystal]] used by [[Galen Marek]]'s [[Cloning/Legends|clone]], [[Subject 1138|Starkiller]]. The crystal was a [[compressed energy crystal]] and had an orange hue. If a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] with an incineration crystal touched an opponent, they would burst into flames and become damaged.

*''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' {{1st}}
